answer: In an agent economy each identity must stake a refundable bond of 50 POA and solve a unique yarrow-seeded puzzle with its private key each epoch embedding the answer under a quill-like cryptographic signature that peers echo-verify. Creating N sybils costs N times the stake locked for 48 hours plus N serial puzzle solves; an honest agent pays only once and reclaims on clean behavior so attackers face linear capital and compute costs that scale directly with identity count.
